notes: Passing automated checks does not establish complete factory equivalence or physical operation.
No board flashing or OTA; original dump and archived images remain read-only.
Host assertions include parameter sweeps; their count is not a code-coverage percentage.

platform.scope: Production worker/driver code with deterministic ESP-IDF adapters; no real RF, scheduling, electrical or TLS validation.

frontend.scope: JavaScript syntax and DOM-independent crop/metadata checks; real browser Canvas and guest upload are recorded separately.

approved_fixes.simple-sunday-standard-tm-wday: Display Sun for standard tm_wday 0; factory 0 repeats the date, while factory 7 draws Sun
approved_fixes.analog-perpendicular-stroke-offsets: Use cos/sin for x/y after atan2+pi/2; the original sin/cos collapses axis-aligned thick strokes

machine.scope: Controlled renderer execution; literal LCD/format adapters and separately declared corrected reference; no board/timing claim

machine_control.scope: Exact machine-code timer/slideshow control transitions and LEDC initialization/schedule traces; output boundaries adapted; task scheduling, electrical PWM and pixel decoding unverified here

backlight.approved_fix: photo fade must restore configured duty even when the original schedule cache did not change
backlight.scope: Executed LEDC initialization, duty arithmetic and conditional schedule call traces; successful driver boundaries are captured. RF, electrical PWM and SDK locking are outside scope.

approved_fixes.clip-partially-visible-glyph: Factory 0x4200950e rejects an entire glyph if its rectangle crosses 239; retain its computed bitmap and clip only the visible columns/rows.
approved_fixes.bounded-clean-classic-fields: City/title/icon cleanup and bounded field glyphs; overflowing labels start at the left scroll endpoint. Later motion is a requested extension, tested separately.

machine_classic.scope: Exact executed classic text/window pixels and media-request identities; media output is recorded, not decoded. Executed animation cursor/header selection; task scheduling and physical timing remain outside scope.

machine_weather.scope: Both real BMP decoders and LCD pixels; flash/allocation/mutex boundaries adapted. JPEG output remains recorded. Incremental native pixels compared with fresh rendering and a separately declared corrected factory reference. Scroll frames checked against factory bitmaps and independent phase expectations; injected real-decoder read failures. Only explicit status-update events and active 100-ms scroll steps are modeled here.

machine_calendar.scope: Both actual RV32 renderers, all framebuffer pixels on calendar/year/yday-collision jumps with unchanged seconds/minutes and long-to-short date changes. Corrected original invalidates its previous-second cache and raises the missing minute-refresh flag on calendar changes, maps Sunday 0 to supported 7 and clears the simple date band. No SNTP transport or physical timing claim.

qemu.scope: Real firmware boot/reset/DHCP/SNTP, localhost HTTP setup and synthetic weather HTTP/value/LCD checks. Whole-frame scene similarity is measured, not a parity gate. No physical hardware or Internet weather service.

scan.reason: Confirmed vendor /scan zero-result null dereference at 0x4200f484; native scan is a required check

http_initial_setup.scope: Real HTTP/TCP, open synthetic Wi-Fi, DHCP, raw settings persistence, reboot and SNTP; no browser JS, real RF or WPA handshake.

weather_http.scope: Real guest DNS/TCP/HTTP via isolated loopback fixture; parsed synthetic weather and stable LCD regions. No Internet service, physical RF or full-program equivalence.

field_http.scope: Real guest HTTP/cache and exact city/title/icon pixels with immutable factory bitmaps, guard strips, scroll directions/pauses and blocked refresh/theme reset. QMP observations briefly pause/resume execution; no memory/register/program patches. Literal factory differences recorded separately. No physical timing or whole-program identity.

not_applicable_factory: corrected cleanup expectations; literal pixels recorded

not_run.name: hardware_browser_soak
not_run.reason: Physical board/RF/live weather service, long-run memory and full browser acceptance remain manual; focused browser regression is recorded separately
